interactivity.hero_calendar: Interactive calendar component built with date-fns or react-day-picker allowing live slot reservation.
interactivity.opportunity_cards: Hover states featuring smooth scaling (scale-105), a clean box-shadow transition, and subtle brightness adjustment on background images.
interactivity.cta_buttons: Gradients should use dynamic background-position transitions on hover to create a shimmering motion effect.

reusable_react_components: SectionWrapper: A generic responsive container with customizable background colors and padding.
GradientButton: Pill-shaped CTA button with gradient border or background options.
OpportunityCard: 1:1 aspect ratio card with absolute positioned text overlay and zoom-on-hover background image.
ReviewCard: Minimal benefit/feature card utilizing SVG icons and robust spacing.

seo_considerations.semantic_tags: Ensure standard heading levels (H1 in hero, H2 for section headings, H3 for cards).
seo_considerations.structured_data: Implement BreadcrumbList and Organization JSON-LD schemas targeting B2B procurement terms.
seo_considerations.image_alt: All opportunity card overlays must double as semantic image alt attributes.

accessibility_considerations.color_contrast: Ensure white text overlays on Opportunity Cards use a semi-transparent dark linear-gradient background overlay (minimum 40% opacity) for proper AA contrast compliance.
accessibility_considerations.keyboard_navigation: Interactive calendar widget must support full tab-index indexing and arrow-key date selection.
accessibility_considerations.focus_indicators: Distinct focus rings for all buttons, links, and grid options.
